senses.gloss: m. (<he>אתן</he>, sec. r. of <cite ref="A00939"><he>אות</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A01639"><he>אִית</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 19:18">Targ. Ex. XIX, 18</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:13">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא א׳ וכ׳</he> a fire-place of which the fire has been scraped out.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 3:14">Esth. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>זרוק גופר׳ באתוניה</he> cast sulphur into his stove i.e. inflame his passion.
